items.prompt: Why explicitly sort by (-count,symbol) instead of assume a count helper uses the required tie rule?

options.text: Tied counts make every report invalid
options.why: Ties are valid and need a stated order.

options.text: ASCII symbol order is always identical to first encounter
The helper's tie behavior may be a different contract
options.why: Explicit sort keys implement count-descending/symbol-ascending order.

options.text: Sorting changes the underlying frequency counts automatically
options.why: Sorting reorders report entries without changing their counts.

items.explanation: A convenient counting API does not establish the business output ordering. State and test both primary and tie keys.
